items: Which of the following is NOT typically included in the common clauses of Terms of Use? (a) User obligations (b) Privacy and data use © Product advertising (d) Termination of service

What does the “Limitations of Liability” clause in Terms of Use usually do? (a) Ensures the company takes full responsibility for all issues (b) Limits the company's liability if things go wrong (c) Provides user rights for any damages (d) Guarantees service availability at all times
Which of the following is a harmful software that secretly monitors your computer or phone activities? (a) Spam (b) Cookies (c) Spyware (d) Pharming
Which of the following threats involves redirecting users to fake websites without their knowledge? (a) Phishing (b) Spam (c) Spyware (d) Pharming

How does the digital divide affect education? (a) It improves learning for all students (b) It has no impact on education (c) It creates inequality in access to digital learning resources (d) It makes traditional teaching methods obsolete

What does data provenance refer to? (a) The cost of accessing the information. (b) The history and origins of the data. (c) The popularity of the information source. (d) The translation of information into multiple languages.

Why is understanding bias important when evaluating information? (a) To ignore opposing viewpoints. (b) To recognize and account for a source's viewpoint or agenda. (c) To validate all sources as equally reliable. (d) To avoid evaluating the information altogether.

Which of the following is a positive impact of computing systems on society? (a) Increased spread of misinformation (b) Improved accessibility to information (c) Privacy concerns (d) Unequal access to technology

What does ethical use of information involve? (a) Copying content without permission. (b) Respecting copyright and avoiding plagiarism. (c) Ignoring data sources when sharing information. (d) Using unverified information for reports.

Which of the following is NOT a sign of responsible digital behavior? (a) Using secure websites for personal data sharing. (b) Spreading false information on social media. (c) Respecting others' privacy online. (d) Reporting suspicious online activities.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: In question 1 the third option is printed with the symbol “©”; it is option (c).

items: Why is it important for users to understand Terms of Use?
Differentiate between phishing and pharming.
Describe how cookies can be both beneficial and invasive to privacy. Give an example of each scenario.
Identify two impacts of the digital divide on social and civic participation.
What are the key steps involved in evaluating information sources?
Explain how computing systems have impacted communication in society.
How does responsible data sharing contribute to ethical use of information?
Describe two ways to recognize online threats and prevent cybersecurity risks.
Explain the common clauses found in Terms of Use and describe how they protect both the service provider and the user.
Explain the concept of bridging the digital divide and discuss the roles of government initiatives in addressing this issue. Provide relevant examples from Pakistan.
Explain how critical thinking skills contribute to responsible information utilization. Provide examples of how these skills can be applied in real-life scenarios.
Discuss the importance of collaborative problem solving in a digital environment and provide examples of how human-machine collaboration can enhance this process.
Explain the concept of creating accessible digital content and describe strategies to ensure digital inclusivity for individuals with disabilities.
